name: Enhanced Protection (Monster)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Energy resistance racial trait.

Benefit(s): Two types of energy resistance you possess from your race increases by 5 for every 5 Hit Dice you possess, to a maximum of 30.

Special: You may select this feat multiple times, each time applying it to two different types of energy resistance.
